name: CropSuite — A Seed of Hope
note: These are POETIC ON-SCREEN captions grounded in the visible action, NOT a verified transcript of the embedded audio. For true subtitles, transcribe and align the audio and use verbatim text.
placementNote: Placements were checked against frames of the master MP4. c5 and c6 moved to upper-left: the children-at-the-table scene has a window in the upper-right corner and the market scene puts the farmer right of centre.

cues.text: She carries more than a hoe.
cues.visual: Walking with hoe; white space to right

cues.text: Every season begins with a question.
cues.visual: Empty field and newly appearing furrows

cues.text: Will there be enough for her children?
cues.visual: Children at the table (window in the upper-right corner)

cues.text: Will her harvest support her family?
cues.visual: Market baskets and coins; farmer right of centre

cues.text: She knows the soil. But tomorrow is uncertain.
What if knowledge could guide her?
Compare crops. Consider climate. Plan what comes next.
A clearer choice can begin a new season.
And from one small seed... hope begins again.

reasonForEndSilence: The CropSuite brand and A Seed of Hope title are already baked into the film at the ending. Do not overlay duplicate title text.
